messages.content: What is plan quantity on a work order in AgileAssets?

expectedOutput: Plan Quantity is the planned amount of work for a work order activity (units depend on the activity). Explain in AgileAssets terms, cite a Public documentation URL from docsagileassets.atlassian.net or docs.agileassets.com, and do not invent live work-order counts.

messages.content: How do day cards work in AgileAssets?

expectedOutput: Provide step-oriented guidance for Day Cards using AgileAssets terminology (day cards, work orders, labor/equipment/material). Include a Public documentation URL. Do not call day cards timesheets.

messages.content: Summarize the user-facing AgileAssets 9.3 release notes from public documentation only.

expectedOutput: Summarize 9.3 user-facing changes from Public AgileAssets Learning Center release notes. Label the source as Public and include the public URL. Do not use internal Confluence as the primary source.
